issues: Removing bracketed text with an empty string can merge adjacent outside words, e.g. "foo[bar]baz" becomes "foobaz".
The regex does not remove bracketed text spanning multiple lines because "." does not match newlines by default.
The regex does not handle nested square brackets correctly.
Unmatched opening brackets are left in the extracted text instead of treating the following text as bracket-enclosed.
The default TfidfVectorizer token pattern ignores single-character words, which may be valid words in the extracted text.
